git.inProgress: A {{operation}} is in progress in the repository; the person finishes or aborts it first. Nothing was done.
git.integrationWorking: Orchester's local integration is working in the project's checkout right now, so git writes nothing there. Nothing was done; try again once it finished.
git.checkoutReserved: A local integration holds the project's checkout until it is finished or put back on the Local integration page, so git writes nothing there. Nothing was done.
git.resolutionOpen: Run #{{run}}'s conflicts wait to be resolved in its worktree, so git writes nothing there. Nothing was done.
git.runQueued: Run #{{run}} is in the merge queue, which syncs and checks it in its worktree, so git writes nothing there. Nothing was done.
git.tooLarge: The work this would discard is too large to fingerprint (more than {{files}} files or {{megabytes}} MB), so it is not proposed: the card could not tell an edit since from what it showed. Nothing was done.

errors.keyTooLong: A key is at most {{max}} characters.
errors.tag: A tag is one word without spaces, at most {{max}} characters.
errors.secret: The record holds the value of secret {{secret}}, so it wasn't saved. Leave the value out; agents can be given the secret by name.
errors.keychain: The value of secret {{secret}} couldn't be read to keep it out of memory, so the record wasn't saved.
errors.changedMeanwhile: The record changed since this page read it, so nothing was saved. Look at it again and decide on what it says now.
errors.keyTaken: Another active record of this memory has that key. Choose another key, or edit that record instead.
errors.restoreKeyInUse: Can't restore: {{key}} already names an active record. Deprecate that one first.

settings.recordsInvalid: Enter a whole number of records from {{min}} to {{max}}.
settings.tokensInvalid: Enter a whole number of tokens from {{min}} to {{max}}.

refused.notThere: The run is no longer where this page showed it in the merge queue. Look at the queue again.
refused.first: The run is first in line already.
refused.personOnly: Only a person approves a merge from the merge queue. Press Merge into the base branch yourself.
refused.resolve: The run's worktree could not be merged: {{detail}}
